items.title: General Mills Is Fighting Inflation and Soft Demand. Earnings Will Show Its Progress.
items.summary: General Mills  is set to report fiscal first-quarter results Wednesday morning.  General Mills is facing high inflation while its cost-saving initiatives are still ramping up.  The company told investors in July that first-quarter sales and profit growth would fall below its full-year ranges, but notes that cost savings are expected to pick up as the year progresses.
